title: txn row id 2: seed allocate of 100000.50 MNT to cashier 2, stored at DECIMAL(19,6) 100000.500000
_note: cashier-txn-amount movement. request.txn_type 101 and request.txn_amount "100000.50" are the txn-type id and exact amount of row id 2 of the cashier-2 transaction list (txns-cashier2-raw.json), the SEED allocate that the summary pre/post/final reads carry first. expect.txn_type_id 101, txn_type_value "Allocate Cash" and txn_amount_minor 10000050 are that row's txnType and its txnAmount 100000.500000 transcribed to integer minor units; the DECIMAL(19,6) spelling is exact, with no HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie, so there is no rounding surface. Pins a second stored allocate amount (BR-01 pins the run's 100000.50) from the transaction read-back that carries the rows behind the summary; wrong implementations that raise the money cell (branch-wrong-off-by-one) or transposed the allocate label (branch-wrong-txn-label-transposed) go red.
